correctness.rationale: At two layers C_2 is exactly a uniform r-subset quadratic codegree sum. Double counting and constant row/column sums give zero-centered-degree sums, so ordered edge pair inner products are H, -2H, H and the variance is (alpha-2beta+gamma)H = κH with κ positive. This proves the iff design criterion, four-cycle relation and both 7-vertex examples. Exact script verifies 1548 instances but the proof covers all d,r in range.
